description:
PHANTOM-ROVER | Logic Club Casa

We are from Logic Club Casablanca, Morocco, joining via Universal Event. Project: PHANTOM-ROVER, inspired by Opportunity rover's last message "My battery is low and it's getting dark". We continue his Mars mission.

Challenge: Abandoned but not Forgotten
Skills: Robotics, Storytelling, 3D Design
#LogicClub #NASA
summary: We are Logic Club from Morocco. NASA left equipment abandoned on the Moon and Mars. How can we bring it back without fuel and without breaking it? Our project turns this problem into a detective case. We investigated the evidence, solved the mystery with logic, and proposed a fuel-free recovery using two spacecraft with symmetric force and an electrodynamic tether, inspired by NASA's TSS-1. Our PDF makes this complex science fun and easy for students to understand.
details:
Our project is a 16-page detective story PDF by Logic Club. Part 1 introduces our team and how we solve puzzles. Part 2 is a warm-up magic puzzle to show our logic method. Part 3 is the main NASA case: abandoned spacecraft and equipment.

The Problem: Equipment is left on the Moon and Mars. Bringing it back is expensive and risky.

Our Solution: First, two spacecraft hold the object together with symmetric force to keep it stable. Then, an electrodynamic tether, like NASA's TSS-1 and TSS-1R missions, de-orbits it slowly to Earth without fuel.

We used logic, NASA data, and storytelling to make students love space. No code was needed, the power is in the idea and the explanation.
